reviewer_role: independent source-review subagent; not implementation author and not WebChat
disposition: No concrete blocking defect found in scoped pre-execution review. Local preregistration commit and every frozen runtime gate remain required before and during execution.

source_bindings.inherited_review_scope: Only relevant existing selector/features/cache/loss/loader/replay/counter dependencies; not a new full-repository audit

tests.scope: CPU synthetic inputs only; no real checkpoint, dataset, Replay or JAX execution

review_checks.conditional_labels: Labels bind to each current callback candidate set and student-conditioned reservations; no independent-trajectory ordinal alignment. Labels/priority/seed/opponent-private data do not enter numeric deployment inputs.
review_checks.warm_start: One fixed 512-update fit from original task tensors; original mean/scale bytes and crop weights retained; one final model; no model selection. Initial/final real-file identity checks remain runtime obligations.
review_checks.training: Uniform replacement sampling of 128 old-train plus 128 new-train groups; weights from old train only; whole groups preserved; shared weighted-loss denominator; compact padding equivalence covered. CPU float64 deployment and float32 training remain explicitly distinct.
review_checks.entry_and_stage_order: First four official filename games must pass before further collection; first-seed round2 both seats compare all719 original-student requests. Maximum136 games, with separate offline/development gates before holdout and no retries/refits.
review_checks.statistics: Eight complete seed clusters retain all opponents/seats/arms;20000 fixed bootstrap draws. Improvement over S and retention against hybrid teacher T are separate gates;96 holdout games are not treated as96 independent samples.
review_checks.budgets_and_lifecycle: Game reservations include attempted/inflight jobs; model counters debit before calls; offline and padding budgets include stated scoring/compile scope. Linux guard retains session identity through cleanup; Windows requires guard acknowledgement and does not equate killing wsl with Linux child cleanup.
review_checks.preservation_and_privacy: Frozen identities and preregistration Git blobs are checked by actual readiness path. Old models/sources retain hashes; general historic artifacts use size/mtime preservation, not a claim of content rehash. Raw observations/weights/Replay/traces/logs/private launch/device data remain local; public export still requires whitelist checks.

evidence_limits: This certificate is pre-execution source/contract review, not successful training, economic improvement, or complete official-game acceptance.
Reviewer did not read real checkpoint tensors, training arrays or Replay files and did not run games, JAX operations or GPU training.
GPU backend discovery and root lifecycle tests do not prove synchronized512-update GPU fit, numerical parity, observed throughput or useful policy improvement.
Actual old/new array identity, warm-start and normalizer preservation, finite synchronized gradients, final CPU/GPU parity and all real-game/replay gates must be proven during the one frozen run.
Current public HEAD is clean baseline; local preregistration commit is still required before collection and is not a third-party timestamp.
Teacher labels are conditional demonstrations, not optimality or reward labels; this task does not expand existing teacher action opportunities.
No second iteration, replacement seeds/checkpoint, automatic default change or PPO is authorized by this certificate.
